geography_scope: Silver Spring CDP, Maryland; not Fenton Village
transform: scripts/prepare_data.py; no boundary simplification; negative counts become null

fenton_village_study_boundary.dataset: Montgomery County Planning Department - Digital Zoning Map, Overlay Zones
fenton_village_study_boundary.purpose: Documented Fenton Village study boundary; used only to select intersecting block groups
fenton_village_study_boundary.published_as_an_area: No. The study boundary selects block groups; it carries no counts and is not served by /areas.

fenton_village_block_groups.selection_method: Whole 2020 Census block groups whose polygon intersects the adopted Fenton Village (FV) Overlay Zone. Spatial selection, joined by GEOID, never by name. These three cover 100% of the study area; no other block group intersects it.
fenton_village_block_groups.selection_reproduction: scripts/verify_geography.py (requires shapely; not run at build or startup)
fenton_village_block_groups.counts_describe: Each whole block group, not the Fenton Village study area. Only 5.7%-31.4% of each block group lies inside the study area, so these counts must never be summed into a Fenton Village total.
fenton_village_block_groups.geography_scope: Whole 2020 block groups intersecting the Fenton Village (FV) Overlay Zone; counts describe each block group, not the study boundary
fenton_village_block_groups.contains_cdp_overlap: These block groups lie inside the Silver Spring CDP polygon. Never add their counts to the CDP totals.
